implementationPlan.description: Re-measure the six-path ownership boundary before edits: record HEAD/status and physical line counts; confirm the four child paths are absent and the unchanged compiled-authority-bodies.js bridge has the exact one-line LF payload. Run reachability and SHAPE searches (not only a symbol grep) across apps/** and packages/** for compiledPlanAuthority, literal result/authority key arrays, Object.keys/Object.isFrozen expectations, hard-coded lengths/counts, bridge-roster regexes, and canonical byte/hash assertions; stop rather than take an unlisted path if a new asserting consumer appears. Record the production call in compile-dispatcher.ts and read-only tests/runtime enumerator. Verify apps/daemon/package.json and the apps/daemon pnpm-lock importer both link @moe/core and @moe/scheduler, then in one Node command write a temporary TS probe under apps/daemon/src/planning that bare-imports the four consumed symbols, compile only that root with the parsed daemon tsconfig, delete it in finally, assert exit 0 and absence. Capture merge-base baseline outputs for daemon typecheck/package tests and root lanes so later red can be path-attributed.

In compiled-authority-bodies.test.ts, first characterize the pre-split real compiledPlanAuthority surface and show the focused test remains green: pin literal canonical graph/plan/acceptance bytes (including the full graphContentBytesBase64 fixture), the measured byte lengths and SHA-256/submission/graph/criterion digests, exact result and authority key order, exact freeze topology, and bidirectional exact public namespace {compiledPlanAuthority}. Add a seven-row refusal table with a denominator assertion and exact code, detail, layer=COMPILED_PLAN_PRODUCER, and frozen result for malformed shape, unbound criteria, uncataloged capabilities, dependencies, and budget. Add divergence arms: empty graphRevisionRef reaches only top approval and yields COMPILED_PLAN_ADMISSION_REFUSED with PLAN_REVISION_MALFORMED@PLAN_REVISION_ADMISSION; a valid 10k objective avoids shape/top-approval fences and reaches only the scheduler node limit with its distinct NODE_AUTHORITY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED detail; empty author passes policy construction but preserves the plain thrown plan-revision error. Add a durable child-process test using process.execPath/argv/shell:false that imports the unchanged compiled-authority-bodies.js bridge, asserts the exact one-key namespace, calls the canonical valid fixture, and checks the same digests. Finally add structural/runtime expectations that all three TS production files are <250 lines and both new exact LF bridges import successfully; run `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon exec vitest run --root . --config package.json src/planning/compiled-authority-bodies.test.ts` and record the expected red specifically for the missing child modules/over-cap monolith before production edits.

Create compiled-approval-authority-body.ts as the focused approval/acceptance constructor (<250 physical lines): move nodePlanning/statement construction plus top-level createPlanRevision/createAcceptanceContract use without altering constants, insertion order, freezing, hashing, validation, or thrown-error behavior. Export only internal createCompiledNodePlanning and createCompiledApprovalAuthorityBody for the coordinator/policy module; return an internal success/refusal shape but leave all stable external reason-code/layer mapping in the old coordinator. Use runtime imports from @moe/core and type-only coordinator imports. Create compiled-approval-authority-body.js with the exact LF bytes `export * from "./compiled-approval-authority-body.ts";\n`; do not change or re-export it from the old public bridge.

Create compiled-policy-authority-body.ts as the focused scheduler/graph constructor (<250 physical lines): move graph constants/predicates/issues, node definitions, edges/interfaces/contracts, graph content encoding/validation/hash, and budget enforcement byte-for-byte. Import scheduler runtime symbols only from @moe/scheduler and createCompiledNodePlanning through `./compiled-approval-authority-body.js`; use type-only coordinator imports. Export only CompiledPolicyAdmissionError and createCompiledPolicyAuthorityBody so expected policy refusals are distinguishable from plain approval/node-planning exceptions. Create compiled-policy-authority-body.js with exact LF bytes `export * from "./compiled-policy-authority-body.ts";\n`, preserving runtime NodeNext resolution and adding no alternate codec, digest, or authority.

Reduce compiled-authority-bodies.ts below 250 physical lines to the public coordinator while preserving its exported input/result types and sole runtime export compiledPlanAuthority. Keep shape validation, LAYER/refused mapping, and outer composition here; call policy construction first, then approval construction with the exact graphContentHash; catch only CompiledPolicyAdmissionError; map approval refusal to the existing COMPILED_PLAN_ADMISSION_REFUSED detail/layer; and construct the frozen outer result in the original property order with the original base64 conversion and unfrozen authority wrapper. Do not edit callers or compiled-authority-bodies.js. Close the TDD red with the focused one-file command from step 2 and require all canonical/refusal/divergence/plain-Node/line/bridge assertions green rather than weakening literals.

Perform the single end-stage adversarial review over the exact six-path diff. Invoke the adversarial-self-review discipline and inspect runtime cycles, erased type-only imports, public/export set equality, exact object insertion/freezing, catch scope, and bridge LF bytes. Before drills run `git status --porcelain --` on every mutated path; copy each post-implementation target to a worker-suffixed out-of-tree %TEMP% backup. Drill (1) change one valid policy-revision byte in compiled-policy-authority-body.ts while keeping the canonical fixture otherwise admissible so no refusal fence can answer first, and require the named literal canonical-byte/hash assertion to red; drill (2) swap two outer success-result properties in compiled-authority-bodies.ts and require the exact key-order assertion to red. A green mutant is a finding, not a pass. Restore in a separate operation, then in another separate call prove SHA-256 equality against each backup (mandatory for the new/untracked policy file) and confirm no drill-only delta remains; rerun the focused test only after byte restoration.

Run the final verification once, in foreground and unpiped, and inspect output rather than exit code alone. Primary completion evidence command: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon exec vitest run --root . --config package.json src/planning/compiled-authority-bodies.test.ts src/planning/compile-dispatcher.test.ts src/orchestrator/compiled-node-source.test.ts src/runtime-entrypoint.test.ts`; require `Test Files 4 passed` and a nonzero Tests count, which includes the durable plain-Node import through compiled-authority-bodies.js and exact bridge-roster coverage. Separately run `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck`, `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm verify:foundation`, and `pnpm verify:store`; each is standalone/unpiped, and record nonzero Test Files/Tests lines for test legs. Recheck all three production TS files are <250 physical lines, both new JS bridges are exact one-line LF files, the old bridge is byte-unchanged, public namespace is exactly one key, and `git diff --check` is clean. Compare merge-base and delivered HEAD failing-path sets, require no new failure intersecting the six owned paths, and disclose any foreign baseline failures verbatim rather than fabricating green.
